Frequently asked questions

What is a good New Year caption for Instagram?

+

A short line that either closes the old year or opens the new one: "see you next year", "goodbye 2026, you were a lot" or "hello 2027, be gentle". Keep it to one line so the photos lead.

Should I post a New Year's Eve dump or a year-in-review dump?

+

They're different posts. A New Year's Eve dump shows the night; a year-in-review dump shows the whole year, usually with one photo per month. If you have the photos, post both a few days apart.

When should I post my New Year photo dump?

+

The night itself or New Year's Day for the party dump. A year in review can go up any time from the last week of December to early January.

How many photos should a New Year dump have?

+

8 to 12 for the night. A year in review can use more, since Instagram allows up to 20 photos and videos in one carousel.

Can I use these New Year captions for free?

+

Yes. Every caption on this page is original writing and free to copy, edit and post. No credit needed.
